artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan closing the re-measured verification-trust and hygiene bundle: deploy-ordering error disposition, defect-acceptance-criterion re-scoping, literature-retrieve.sh quarantine plus the folded-in 3-script manifest registration, ROADMAP.md deletion with its required roadmap-integration.sh companion fix, live topic-taxonomy reconciliation, CLAUDE.md and utility-inventory documentation gaps, @.claude/docs prose normalization, and a closing full gate run.

memory_candidates.content: A decision to delete a generated-or-annotated file does not stick unless the tooling that consumes it also stops auto-creating it on absence. roadmap-integration.sh heredocs a fresh empty ROADMAP.md stub whenever the file is missing, so a bare rm regenerates it on the next /review or /todo run. The general pattern: before planning any file deletion, grep the consumers for an 'if [[ ! -f ... ]]' create-default branch, and pair the deletion with a change that converts that branch into a structured skip (stable warning code + empty-state payload + exit 0) registered in every caller's warning vocabulary. Absence must become a supported state, not a repair trigger.
